# Trailkit Outdoor

Trailkit picks tents, pads, packs, boots, stoves, and shells for a real constraint: budget, weight, weather, width, or a first night out.

Trailkit Outdoor is an Amazon Associate site. Buy buttons go to Amazon.com, the US store.

## Main sections

https://www.trailkitoutdoor.com/best
Each page answers one buying question, compares the real options, and names one pick to start with.

https://www.trailkitoutdoor.com/guides
The decision, explained, then a link to the roundup where the buying happens.

https://www.trailkitoutdoor.com/compare
Two options, one job. If the fit is wrong, neither wins.

https://www.trailkitoutdoor.com/kits
A short list for a kind of trip. Swap a piece if the constraint does not match you.

https://www.trailkitoutdoor.com/gear
Each category page explains the decision, then links to the gear and the roundups that use it.

https://www.trailkitoutdoor.com/learn
Definitions and judgment calls that the gear pages assume. Read the note, then open the roundup if you are ready to buy.

https://www.trailkitoutdoor.com/library
An index of every page on the site. The cards are a sample. The lists below are complete.
